purpose: Passively retain and independently regrade both cross-sign exact-a729 controller/UI/WorldFrame selected-Present cases that occur while the user plays.

observation_contract.source: immutable per-observation JSON receipts emitted by an already-present passive collector
observation_contract.engine_evidence: post-original terminal controller values and range/record presence
observation_contract.world_frame_evidence: early-render candidate selected for the WorldFrame
observation_contract.selected_present_evidence: authenticated selected/cutoff QPC and receipt SHA-256
observation_contract.selection: first valid immutable receipt for each required opposite-sign pair

required_parameters: PID of the already-running exact-a729 client
collector_prerequisite: The collector must spool a new immutable A37 receipt for every qualifying callback/selected-Present join instead of a single fixed one-shot filename. Installation belongs to the surrounding passive capture session and is not performed by this adapter.

promotion_disposition.controller_spine_fixture: eligible only after passive observations regrade successfully
